title: A configuration outside the stopping set is live
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-tape Turing machine with state set $S$, and let $\mathrm{stopAt}:S\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be a stopping predicate. If $c$ is not stopped—meaning its state is present and is not designated as a stopping state—then there is a state $s\in S$ such that $c$ has state $s$ and $\mathrm{stopAt}(s)=\mathrm{false}$.
hypotheses_covered: A stopping predicate from states to Boolean values
A configuration of a $k$-tape Turing machine
